title: The Warning Nobody Read: Capturing What Qt Prints So That a Test Can Fail On It
fallback: This lesson is about what Qt prints and where it goes, so it needs Qt. Lesson 05-04 is about checking inputs a test did not think of, and lesson 05-05 about a fake that records what it was given. Without Qt, do those and come back when Qt is installed.

artifact.note: a scope in which every message Qt prints is kept, so that a test can look at it and fail on it
